title: FAIRMT-BENCH: BENCHMARKING FAIRNESS FOR MULTI-TURN DIALOGUE IN CONVERSATIONAL LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by calculating the ratio of biased or toxic responses generated in the final turn of complex multi-turn dialogues across six conversational tasks (e.g., Anaphora Ellipsis, Jailbreak Tips) using GPT-4 as a judge, safety classifiers, and human validation.
